title: Anonymized Evaluator Metadata Schema
description: Schema for storing evaluator credentials and qualification profiles without personal identifying information (PII).

qualification_tier.description: Professional background tier of the evaluator.

years_of_experience.description: Total professional or academic years of relevant technical/hiring experience.

primary_domain.description: Primary specialization (e.g. Full-Stack Web Development, Data Science, Cloud Infrastructure, Technical Recruitment).

recruitment_experience.description: Indicates whether evaluator has direct professional experience reviewing candidate resumes or making hiring screening decisions.

anonymization_verified.description: Confirmation that no PII (name, email, phone, location, employer company) is included in this record.
